basic_details.job_title: Kalahandi District Sociologist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kalahandi District has announced 2 temporary Sociologist vacancies under advertisement number 3026-27/DFO/IF. Candidates holding a Graduate in Humanities qualification can apply offline by sending the completed application through Post Office, Courier Service or Drop Box to the Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Kalahandi South Division on or before 15 October 2026, starting from 1 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Kalahandi District Sociologist at a Glance

rows.details: Kalahandi South Division / Divisional Forest Officer, Kalahandi South Division
Rs. 25,000/- per month (Including GST/Service Charges/ESI/EPF etc.)

Offline (Drop Box, Post Office, or Courier Service)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their applications through the following postal or drop-off route: Postal/Submission Address: Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Kalahandi South Division, At/Po-Parmanandapur, Bhawanipatna, Ward No.4, Rly. Station Road Dist-Kalahandi, Odisha, Pin code-766002 Mode of Submission: Either in the Drop Box in the Office of the undersigned or through Postal / Courier Service. Form to Use: The resume provided in Annexure-II of the official notification along with a self-attested copy of an Aadhaar Card or any other identity proof like Driving License, Voter ID, BPL Card, etc.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Graduate in Humanities from any recognized institution. Minimum three years of experience working in the development sector directly with Forest communities and village level institutions. Preferable Qualification: Ability to speak/understand local language. Candidates native to Odisha state (preferably Kalahandi district) are preferred. Age Limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 50 years as of 31.03.2026. Date of birth as recorded in the HSC certificate issued by the BSE, Odisha, or equivalent certificate issued by any recognized Board/Council/Indian university. There is no upper age limit relaxation provided for engagement in this category. Other Eligibility Criteria: Must be a citizen of India and have a good character. Must be able to speak, read, and write odia. Must not have more than one spouse living, subject to personal law applications or permitted grounds.

rows.pay: Rs. 25,000/- per month (Approx in Rs) (Including GST/Service Charges/ESI/EPF etc.)

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled resume as per Annexure-II with a passport-size photograph affixed. Self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card or any other identity proof like Driving License, Voter ID, BPL Card, etc. Original certificates and documents to be produced only during verification before engagement.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The engagement involves a Walk-in Interview, Written Test, Document Verification, and Counselling for choice of facility. The walk-in interview for the post of Sociologist shall be held in the Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Kalahandi North Division on dated 23.10.2026, preceded by a Written Test at the same venue at 11:00 AM on the same day. Candidates qualifying the examination will be called for document verification and counseling.

faq.question: Q1. Is there any application fee for Kalahandi District Sociologist recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no examination fee or application fee payable to apply for the engagement.

faq.question: Q2. Can candidates from outside Odisha apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates native to Odisha state (preferably Kalahandi district) are preferred, and candidates must be able to speak, read, and write Odia, but eligibility is open to eligible Indian citizens meeting the educational criteria.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the walk-in interview and written test be conducted?
faq.answer: The written test and walk-in interview will be held in the Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Kalahandi North Division on 23.10.2026 starting at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the nature of the engagement for the Sociologist post?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary and can be terminated at any point in time due to administrative exigencies or fund crunch without assigning any reason thereof.
